title: Combined input and proof word
statement: Let $A$ be an alphabet, let $n$ and $\ell$ be natural numbers, and let $w$ and $q$ be words of lengths $n$ and $\ell$, respectively. The combined word on the disjoint union of the input and proof positions agrees with $w$ on input positions and with $q$ on proof positions.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a word of length $n$ over $A$
$q$ is a word of length $\ell$ over $A$
